svg.title: Counter ownership and guarded stores — completion_counter_clear
svg.desc: Every lane and all 300 live counter elements are shown; padded launch lanes are gray.
svg.text: Example CounterCount=300 → 2 blocks × 256 threads; one int32 store per live thread.
Counter 299 = block 1 / warp 1 / lane 11 → global byte 1196; store bits 0xFFFFFFFF.
Counter 300 and later fail the guard. Gray cells issue no store. No model token, shared tile or MMA exists here.
Enqueue before split users. The later producers’ readiness protocol is separate from this initialization.
